prompt:
Build a closed-loop, multi-domain horizontal-axis wind-turbine model. The physical system must contain a grounded tower that supports a yawing nacelle, a finite-inertia three-blade rotor with aerodynamic loads applied to the blades, a connected drivetrain and brake, a generator with an electrical grid path, three hydraulic blade-pitch actuators, and electrically driven geared nacelle-yaw actuation. The commands and logged outputs must arise from this causal physical system; prescribed output motion, replayed trajectories, or measurements disconnected from the plant are not valid.

Read wind_time_s, wind_speed_mps, and wind_direction_deg from the MATLAB base workspace. wind_time_s starts at zero and is strictly increasing. The three vectors have equal length. Wind speed may range from 0 to 20 m/s, and signed wind direction may range from -35 to 35 degrees. Use the supplied samples as a time-varying wind command, with a reasonable continuous interpolation between breakpoints.

Use closed-loop pitch action to regulate the rotor and generator operating condition and to limit aerodynamic loading as wind speed changes. Use closed-loop yaw action to reduce signed wind-direction misalignment. Supervisory behavior must support generation start, high-wind regulation, and safe reduction or interruption of generation when the operating state requires it. Pitch, yaw, braking, and generation changes must act through their modeled actuators and connected mechanical or electrical paths. The internal controller equations and coordinate conventions are not prescribed.

Log six complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named wind_response, pitch_response, hydraulic_effort, yaw_response, drivetrain_response, and generation_response. wind_response contains [applied wind speed (m/s), applied wind direction (deg), measured nacelle yaw angle (deg)]. pitch_response contains [collective pitch command (deg), measured blade pitch (deg)]. hydraulic_effort contains the three physical pitch-actuator forces in N. yaw_response contains [yaw command (deg), measured nacelle yaw angle (deg), four physical yaw-motor torques (N*m)]. drivetrain_response contains [rotor speed (rad/s), generator speed (rpm), low-speed drivetrain torque (N*m)]. generation_response contains generator active electrical power in W. All logged signals must be finite, time aligned, and produced by the same causal simulation.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH02.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH02.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
